verdict.rationale: Angular's docs describe a modular architecture built on components with fine-grained reactive state updates via Signals. Community reports corroborate that Angular components are encapsulated and truly reusable, and that @Input/@Output enables modular composition. Older AngularJS-era complaints about its directives API concern the predecessor framework and do not contradict this. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of component-local state management and composition patterns (the evidence is marketing-level taglines), and recent hands-on corroboration of building complex UIs from composed components.
